name: Thomas' Original "Nooks & Crannies" English Muffins
whyItWorks: A beloved digestive staple! The airy, open-cell structure toasts up light and crisp. Contains only 1g fiber, 0g dairy, and zero seeds; dusted lightly with degerminated yellow cornmeal that does not trigger strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Split with a fork (never cut with a knife) to preserve the crevices. Toast well and top with butter or a poached egg.
